## 🤖 Jarvis-py Pull Request Checklist

Thank you for contributing to Jarvis! Please verify the following checklist before submitting your PR:

- [ ] I have tested my changes locally (voice capture, tool execution, or wake-word detection).
- [ ] My code adheres to standard PEP-8 style guidelines and repository formatting.
- [ ] I have updated relevant docstrings or documentation in `README.md` / `CHANGELOG.md` if applicable.
- [ ] No private API keys or user data (`user_profile.json`) are included in this PR.
